```{r}
#Setting the date format for the daily mean wind data and then pulling out each year separated.
w2 <- w %>% 
  mutate(measurementTime2 = mdy_hm(measurementTime),
         date = date(measurementTime2),
         year = year(date)) %>%
  filter(year > 2021) %>% 
  select(date, measurementTime = measurementTime2,
         ws = WindSpd_Avg, wd = WindDir_Avg) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Convert to meteorological convention (direction wind is coming FROM)
    # u = eastward component, v = northward component
    u = -ws * sin(wd * pi/180),  # Negative because wd is "from" direction
    v = -ws * cos(wd * pi/180),
    # Calculate SE component for each hourly observation
    se_component = (u - v) / sqrt(2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(ws:se_component), values_to = "val", names_to = "par") %>% 
  group_by(date, par) %>%
  summarise(dm = mean(val, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  ungroup() 

w2_wide <- w2 %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "par", values_from = "dm") %>% 
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  mutate(c_sum = cumsum(se_component)) %>% 
  ungroup()
      
```

```{r}
#Wrangling buoy data for plotting
b2 <- b %>% 
  select(date = date_corr, fl_med_day, group) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date),
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date),
         yday = yday(date)) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) %>% 
  mutate(group = as.character(group))

# Create a temporary dataset with just the gap dates
gap_dates <- data.frame(
  date = seq(as.Date("2024-03-19"), as.Date("2024-03-24"), by = 1)
)

# Get the surrounding data for interpolation context
interp_window <- b2 %>%
  filter(date >= "2024-03-15" & date <= "2024-03-30") %>%
  bind_rows(gap_dates) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    fl_med_day = na.approx(fl_med_day, na.rm = FALSE),
    # Mark interpolated points
    group = ifelse(
      date >= "2024-03-19" & date <= "2024-03-24",
      "interpolated",
      group
    )
  )

# Merge back with original data
b24_gapfilled <- b2 %>%
  bind_rows(
    interp_window %>% filter(date >= "2024-03-19" & date <= "2024-03-24")
  ) %>%
  arrange(date) %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd(date),
         year = year(date),
         month = month(date),
         yday = yday(date)) 
```









```{r}
# Create function to identify consecutive calm periods
identify_calm_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(se_component)) %>%  # Remove rows with missing wind data
    arrange(date2) %>%
    mutate(
      calm = se_component > -1,
      # Identify start/end of calm periods
      calm_start = calm & (lag(calm, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      calm_end = calm & (lead(calm, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      # Create group identifier
      calm_group = cumsum(calm_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(calm == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, calm_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # Only keep periods of 3+ consecutive days
    filter(duration >= 3)
}

# Prepare data - filter out the problematic date first
plot_data_full <- b24_gapfilled %>% 
  full_join(w2_wide) %>%
  mutate(date2 = as.Date(yday, origin = "2024-01-01")) %>%
  filter(date2 != as.Date("2024-12-31"))  # Remove the problematic date

# Create calm periods on full dataset first
calm_periods_full <- plot_data_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(se_component)) %>%
  arrange(year, date2) %>%
  select(year, date2, se_component) %>%
  mutate(
    calm = se_component > -1,
    calm_yesterday = lag(calm, default = FALSE),
    new_calm_period = calm & !calm_yesterday,
    period_id = cumsum(new_calm_period)
  ) %>%
  filter(calm == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(year, period_id) %>%
  summarise(
    start_date = min(date2),
    end_date = max(date2),
    duration = n(),
    avg_wind = mean(se_component),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(duration >= 3)

# Now filter plot data for display and add NA gap for 2025
plot_data <- plot_data_full %>%
  mutate(month = month(date2)) %>%
  filter(month < 7) %>%
  # Add NA gap for 2025 between April 27 and May 11
  mutate(
    se_component = ifelse(
      year == 2025 & date2 >= as.Date("2024-04-27") & date2 <= as.Date("2024-05-11"),
      NA,
      se_component),
    fl_med_day = ifelse(
      year == 2025 & date2 >= as.Date("2024-04-27") & date2 <= as.Date("2024-05-11"),
      NA,
      fl_med_day
    )
  )

# Filter calm periods to only show those that overlap with our plot window
calm_periods <- calm_periods_full %>%
  filter(
    # Keep periods that start before July OR end after January
    (start_date <= as.Date("2024-06-30")) & (end_date >= as.Date("2024-01-01"))
  ) %>%
  # Trim the periods to fit within our plot window
  mutate(
    start_date = pmax(start_date, as.Date("2024-01-01")),
    end_date = pmin(end_date, as.Date("2024-06-30"))
  )

# Create year annotations for top-left of each facet
year_annotations <- data.frame(
  year = c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025),
  date2 = as.Date("2024-01-15"),  # Position at left
  fl_med_day = 18,  # Position at top
  label = c("2022", "2023", "2024", "2025")
)

# Plot with improved layout
plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date2)) +
  # Add shaded areas for calm periods
  geom_rect(data = calm_periods,
            aes(xmin = start_date, xmax = end_date,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            alpha = 0.4, fill = "lightblue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add se_component as line (scaled to fluorescence range)
  geom_line(aes(y = (se_component + 20) * 0.5), color = "gray40", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  # Add calm threshold line
  geom_hline(yintercept = (-1 + 20) * 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
  # Add fluorescence line
  geom_line(aes(y = fl_med_day, color = as.factor(year)), size = 2) +
  # Add year annotations
  geom_text(data = year_annotations,
            aes(x = date2, y = fl_med_day, label = label),
            size = 10, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
            color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Dual y-axis labels
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = bquote("Flu"[BUOY]~"(mg" ~ m^-2*")"),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. / 0.5) - 20, name = "SE Wind Component",
                       breaks = seq(-20, 20, 10))
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b",
               limits = c(as.Date("2024-01-01"), as.Date("2024-06-30"))) +  # Force x-axis limits
  scale_color_jama() +
  facet_grid(year~.) +  # Remove strip.position to use default (no labels)
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(size = 35),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "gray50", size = 30),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "gray50"),
    strip.text = element_blank(),  # Remove facet labels completely
    strip.placement = "outside",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")  # More space for right axis
  )

# Print calm period summary for insight
print("Calm periods summary:")
calm_periods %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    num_calm_periods = n(),
    total_calm_days = sum(duration),
    longest_calm_spell = max(duration),
    avg_calm_duration = mean(duration),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggsave(here("figures", "buoy_spring_wind_calm.png"), 
        width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
      end_date = max(date2),

}
```

```{r}
# Create functions to identify different types of calm periods
identify_se_calm_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(se_component)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%  # Add year to arrange
    group_by(year) %>%  # Group by year
    mutate(
      calm = se_component > -1.5,
      calm_start = calm & (lag(calm, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      calm_group = cumsum(calm_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(calm == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, calm_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)
}

identify_ws_calm_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%  # Add year to arrange
    group_by(year) %>%  # Group by year
    mutate(
      calm = ws < 5,
      calm_start = calm & (lag(calm, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      calm_group = cumsum(calm_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(calm == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, calm_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)
}

# Prepare data - filter out the problematic date first
plot_data_full <- b24_gapfilled %>% 
  full_join(w2_wide) %>%  # Back to using wind data
  mutate(date2 = as.Date(yday, origin = "2024-01-01")) %>%
  filter(date2 != as.Date("2024-12-31"))  # Remove the problematic date

# Create separate calm periods on full dataset
se_calm_periods_full <- identify_se_calm_periods(plot_data_full)
ws_calm_periods_full <- identify_ws_calm_periods(plot_data_full)

# Now filter plot data for display and add NA gap for 2025
plot_data <- plot_data_full %>%
  mutate(month = month(date2)) %>%
  filter(month < 7) %>%
  # Add NA gap for 2025 between April 27 and May 11
  mutate(
    se_component = ifelse(
      year == 2025 & date2 >= as.Date("2024-04-27") & date2 <= as.Date("2024-05-11"),
      NA,
```

```{r}
# Create functions to identify different types of calm periods
identify_se_calm_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(se_component)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      calm = se_component > -1.5,  # Updated threshold
      calm_start = calm & (lag(calm, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      calm_group = cumsum(calm_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(calm == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, calm_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # Updated to 5 days
}

identify_ws_calm_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      calm = ws < 5,  # Changed to <= for consistency
      calm_start = calm & (lag(calm, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      calm_group = cumsum(calm_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(calm == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, calm_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # Updated to 5 days
}

# NEW: Function to identify the critical overlap periods
identify_bloom_trigger_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(se_component) & !is.na(ws)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      # Both conditions must be met
      bloom_conditions = se_component > -1.5 & ws < 5,
      # Only consider periods after March (yday > 60 for March 1st)
      post_march = yday(date2) > 60,
      # Combined trigger condition
      trigger = bloom_conditions & post_march,
      trigger_start = trigger & (lag(trigger, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      trigger_group = cumsum(trigger_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(trigger == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, trigger_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      avg_se_wind = mean(se_component),
      avg_wind_speed = mean(ws),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 5+ consecutive days
}
```

```{r}
# NEW: Function to identify the critical overlap periods
identify_bloom_trigger_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(se_component) & !is.na(ws) & !is.na(dm)) %>%  # All three variables needed
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      # All three conditions must be met
      bloom_conditions = se_component > -1.5 & ws <= 5 & dm > 150,
      # Only consider periods after March (yday > 60 for March 1st)
      post_march = yday(date2) > 60,
      # Combined trigger condition
      trigger = bloom_conditions & post_march,
      trigger_start = trigger & (lag(trigger, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      trigger_group = cumsum(trigger_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(trigger == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, trigger_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      avg_se_wind = mean(se_component),
      avg_wind_speed = mean(ws),
      avg_par = mean(dm),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

# NEW: Function to identify PAR periods
identify_par_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(dm)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      high_light = dm > 150,
      light_start = high_light & (lag(high_light, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      light_group = cumsum(light_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(high_light == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, light_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 3)  # 6+ consecutive days
}
```

```{r}
# Function to identify favorable conditions combining ws^3 and PAR
identify_ws_cube_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      calm = (ws^3) < 500,  # Low wind energy
      calm_start = calm & (lag(calm, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      calm_group = cumsum(calm_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(calm == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, calm_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

identify_par_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(dm)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      high_light = dm > 200,
      light_start = high_light & (lag(high_light, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      light_group = cumsum(light_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(high_light == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, light_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

# Function for combined bloom trigger periods
identify_bloom_trigger_periods <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(ws) & !is.na(dm)) %>%
    arrange(year, date2) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(
      # Both conditions: low wind energy AND sufficient light
      bloom_conditions = (ws^3) < 500 & dm > 200,
      # Only consider periods after February (yday > 32)
      post_feb = yday(date2) > 32,
      # Combined trigger condition
      trigger = bloom_conditions & post_feb,
      trigger_start = trigger & (lag(trigger, default = FALSE) == FALSE),
      trigger_group = cumsum(trigger_start)
    ) %>%
    filter(trigger == TRUE) %>%
    group_by(year, trigger_group) %>%
    summarise(
      start_date = min(date2),
      end_date = max(date2),
      duration = n(),
      avg_wind_cube = mean(ws^3),
      avg_par = mean(dm),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(duration >= 6)  # 6+ consecutive days
}

# Use wind data as the base (since it has complete coverage) and join others to it
plot_data_full <- w2_wide %>%
  full_join(b24_gapfilled, by = c("year", "date")) %>%
  full_join(p2, by = c("year", "date")) %>%
  mutate(date2 = as.Date(yday, origin = "2024-01-01")) %>%
  filter(date2 != as.Date("2024-12-31")) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) %>%
  # Set fluorescence to NA for the gap period only (but keep wind/PAR data)
  mutate(
    fl_med_day = ifelse(
      year == 2025 & date2 >= as.Date("2024-04-27") & date2 <= as.Date("2024-05-11"),
      NA,
      fl_med_day
    )
  )

# Create period datasets
ws_cube_periods_full <- identify_ws_cube_periods(plot_data_full)
par_periods_full <- identify_par_periods(plot_data_full) 
bloom_trigger_periods_full <- identify_bloom_trigger_periods(plot_data_full)

# Filter for plot data
plot_data <- plot_data_full %>%
  mutate(month = month(date2)) %>%
  filter(month < 7)

# Filter periods for plot window
ws_cube_periods <- ws_cube_periods_full %>%
  filter(
    (start_date <= as.Date("2024-06-30")) & (end_date >= as.Date("2024-01-01"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    start_date = pmax(start_date, as.Date("2024-01-01")),
    end_date = pmin(end_date, as.Date("2024-06-30"))
  )

par_periods <- par_periods_full %>%
  filter(
    (start_date <= as.Date("2024-06-30")) & (end_date >= as.Date("2024-01-01"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    start_date = pmax(start_date, as.Date("2024-01-01")),
    end_date = pmin(end_date, as.Date("2024-06-30"))
  )

bloom_trigger_periods <- bloom_trigger_periods_full %>%
  filter(
    (start_date <= as.Date("2024-06-30")) & (end_date >= as.Date("2024-01-01"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    start_date = pmax(start_date, as.Date("2024-01-01")),
    end_date = pmin(end_date, as.Date("2024-06-30"))
  )

# Create year annotations for all years
year_annotations <- data.frame(
  year = c(2022, 2023, 2024, 2025),
  date2 = as.Date("2024-01-15"),
  fl_med_day = 18,
  label = c("2022", "2023", "2024", "2025")
)

# Create the plot
plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date2)) +
  # Add shaded areas for low wind energy periods (light blue)
  geom_rect(data = ws_cube_periods,
            aes(xmin = start_date, xmax = end_date,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            alpha = 0.2, fill = "lightblue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add shaded areas for high PAR periods (light yellow) 
  geom_rect(data = par_periods,
            aes(xmin = start_date, xmax = end_date,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            alpha = 0.2, fill = "yellow", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add BLOOM TRIGGER periods (dark purple)
  geom_rect(data = bloom_trigger_periods,
            aes(xmin = start_date, xmax = end_date,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            alpha = 0.5, fill = "purple", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Add wind speed cubed line
  geom_line(aes(y = (ws^3) / 200), color = "gray40", size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  # Add threshold line for ws^3 < 250
  geom_hline(yintercept = 250 / 200, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  # Add fluorescence line
  geom_line(aes(y = fl_med_day, color = as.factor(year)), size = 2) +
  # Add year annotations
  geom_text(data = year_annotations,
            aes(x = date2, y = fl_med_day, label = label),
            size = 10, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
            color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Dual y-axis labels
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = bquote("Flu"[BUOY]~"(mg" ~ m^-2*")"),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 200, name = bquote("Wind Speed"^3~"(m/s)"^3),
                       breaks = seq(0, 4000, 500))
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "months", date_labels = "%b",
               limits = c(as.Date("2024-01-01"), as.Date("2024-06-30"))) +
  scale_color_jama() +
  facet_grid(year~.) +
  labs(color = NULL) +

print("High PAR periods (dm > 200 for 6+ days) - only years with PAR data:")

print("BLOOM TRIGGER periods (BOTH conditions post-Feb for 6+ days) - only years with PAR data:")
```

```{r}
# Calculate 19-day rolling mean SE component for ALL days, then test against fluorescence
daily_prediction <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(year, date) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    se_19day = zoo::rollmean(se_component, 19, fill = NA, align = "right")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(se_19day), !is.na(fl_med_day)) %>%
  filter(month(date) == 4)  # Focus on April responses

# Test the correlation with all daily April data points
cor.test(daily_prediction$se_19day, daily_prediction$fl_med_day)

# Plot it to see the relationship
ggplot(daily_prediction, aes(x = se_19day, y = fl_med_day, color = as.factor(year))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "19-day mean SE component", 
       y = "Daily fluorescence",
       title = "Daily April fluorescence vs preceding 19-day SE winds") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# Test if the relationship is consistent within years

  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    correlation = cor(se_19day, fl_med_day, use = "complete.obs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
